videos.title: Amne Samne
videos.description: Gopi, a simpleton, plays along when Jyoti mistakes him for Johnny and offers him work. He, however, soon finds himself on the run from the police and the mafia due to his lookalike's criminal deeds.

videos.title: Comedy Station - Bittu Bak Bak
videos.description: Series of short, comedic vignettes where an unlucky Bhojpuri producer Champaklal and his secretary Suzie hilariously navigate chaotic, low-budget filmmaking, trying to outsmart each other.

videos.title: Jaaneman
videos.description: Suhaan, an aspiring actor, is in a fix when Piya files for divorce and forces him to pay a large amount as alimony. To avoid paying her, Suhaan uses Agastya's love for Piya and helps him woo her.

videos.title: Bewafai
videos.description: Asha's jealousy gets the better of her when she finds out that the man she loves, Ashok, is showering attention to Vinny, a woman Asha beats up later, and Renu, a woman who has a cognitive disorder.

videos.title: Ajanabee
videos.description: Middle-classed Rohit (Rajesh Khanna) falls in love with rich Reshmi (Zeenat Aman) and marries her. But fate has other plans and he gets arrested for the murder which he never committed.

videos.title: Agni Sakshi
videos.description: Newly married Suraj and Shivangi are on honeymoon where they meet Vishwanath - who claims that Shivangi is his wife.

videos.title: Anurodh
videos.description: A rich businessman disapproves of his son's passion for singing. This leads to friction between them, causing the boy to leave home. He adopts a new identity when he becomes a popular singer.

videos.title: Aandhi Toofan
videos.description: Inspector Ranjeet nabs the notorious biker-gangster Balbir, but the criminal soon manages to escape and swears vengeance against the police officer and his family.

videos.title: Awaaz
videos.description: Advocate Jayant defends his clients and gets them off the hook, even if they are guilty. However, when his daughter is raped by the son of a gangster he has defended, he vows to take revenge.

videos.title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 2
videos.description: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life.

videos.title: Baharon Ki Manzil
videos.description: A woman (Meena Kumari) whose memory is impaired learns shocking information about her family.

videos.title: Comedy Station - Bittu Bak Bak
videos.description: Series of short, comedic vignettes where an unlucky Bhojpuri producer Champaklal and his secretary Suzie hilariously navigate chaotic, low-budget filmmaking, trying to outsmart each other.

videos.title: Ajnabee Saaya
videos.description: Rakesh's wife dies, then returns. He's shocked and suspicious, trying to uncover her identity.

videos.title: Meherbaan
videos.description: Meherbaan is the story of a family man, who has to decide between commitment, ethics and love between his 2 women.

videos.title: Shakti
videos.description: Ashwini, an honest policeman, refuses to trade a captured gangster for his son Vijay's release after a ruthless gangster kidnaps him. Vijay grows up resenting his father and turns to a life of crime.

videos.title: Safar
videos.description: A pair of lovers are cruelly separated by destiny when the boy is diagnosed with terminal cancer. On his insistence, the girl settles down with another man, but he turns out to be a jealous husband.

videos.title: Professor Ki Padosan
videos.description: Vidyadhar consumes a potion to become invisible in order to escape his wife Shobha's ire when she learns of his affair with Menka.

videos.title: An Evening In Paris
videos.description: A wealthy woman meets a charming but not completely truthful beau in France.

videos.title: Jurrat
videos.description: Inspector Avinash is transferred to Mumbai and is tasked to nab smuggler Kama Seth. When Kama hoodwinks Avinash and makes him a laughing stock in the eyes of the media, he makes a dangerous decision.

videos.title: Conversation With Rajkummar Rao 1
videos.description: Rajkummar Rao, one of the most talented and versatile actors today, talks about his being an outsider to the industry, the different shades of unique characters he plays and his success.

videos.title: Phir Milenge
videos.description: A woman is fired from an ad agency when her employers get to know that she is HIV positive. Upset by her unfair dismissal, she seeks a lawyer to fight her case and restore her dignity.

videos.title: Conversation With Rajkummar Rao 2
videos.description: Rajkummar Rao, one of the most talented and versatile actors today, talks about his being an outsider to the industry, the different shades of unique characters he plays and his success.

videos.title: Jeevan Ek Sanghursh
videos.description: Karan, a thief, works for Dr. Devraj to help keep the evil don Rattan from taking over the city. His life changes when he finds his family that had disowned him when he was a child.

videos.title: Roja
videos.description: Roja lives in a Tamil village, and her sister is about to marry a man from the city, who decides to marry Roja instead and gets a job assignment in Kashmir, where some militants decide to kidnap him.

videos.title: Haye Mera Dil
videos.description: Sangeeta, a renowned dancer, leads a luxurious life. However, she is unaware that the man who claims to be her father is actually a criminal who abducted her years ago.

videos.title: Apne Paraye
videos.description: This is a story of two lawyer brothers, their half brother, their wives and children.

videos.title: Virasat
videos.description: Watch award-winning performances by Anil Kapoor and Tabu in this story of a dutiful son who sacrifices all his happiness to live his father's dream of developing his native village.

videos.title: Bairaag
videos.description: Manservant Bhola is secretly in love with his master's granddaughter but she is set to wed another. But the dowry-demanding groom absconds with the money and Bhola is sent to bring him back.
